NewsArticle.Title: The Eulogy: Adoration
NewsArticle.Content:
[Carnig, priest of Astrid,](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/000423.html) reappears a few weeks before the Spring of the new year, Deoch 12, Year of Luathas, to consumate the adoration of Arpina, Adranuch, and Matrika.
Through the sacrifice of the three relics by a trinity worshippers who have consecrated their spirit by [Redemption,](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/000423.html) each may invoke the spirit of Danaan within their own heart. Come and worship in threes throughout this Temuairan Moon.
As a scripture says, "May our actions be Danaan's smile, may our thought's be Danaan's brilliance, may Danaan's smile appear upon each that you meet, for She resides in the each Aisling's heart. You can only find Her--beginning with faith--or deny Her in whomever you meet."
Blaise
Librarian of Loures
